text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from the data they are given. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups, so fairness must always be considered. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies should protect this data carefully. Transparency is also essential, meaning people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means building systems that are safe, honest, and helpful for everyone in society.
